name: Shopify App Store

sources.title: Submit your app for review — official review flow
App requirements checklist — icon 1200x1200 JPEG/PNG, listing requirements

requirements: You must build a real Shopify app (OAuth install, app URLs, compliance webhooks subscribed) — this is not a listing-only directory
A Shopify Partner account is required to create and submit apps
App icon must be exactly 1200x1200 px JPEG or PNG
Compliance webhooks (privacy-law data callbacks) are mandatory for App Store distribution
Domains and the API contact email must not contain 'Shopify' or misspellings/abbreviations of it
Every submission needs a primary language and at least one complete App Store listing
Automated checks on the review page must pass before submission is allowed
If the app uses protected customer data, that request must be completed BEFORE review starts — it cannot be applied for while under review
preparation: Working Shopify app deployed at stable URLs with OAuth install flow
App icon 1200x1200 JPEG/PNG, listing copy, screenshots per the requirements checklist
Compliance webhook subscriptions implemented (customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact)
Emergency contact email + phone number for critical technical issues
A monitored submission email — whitelist noreply@shopify.com
Protected customer data request form completed beforehand if needed
workflow: In the Partner Dashboard / Dev Dashboard, open the 'Shopify App Store review' page for your app
Complete Configuration: URLs, compliance webhooks, icon, API contact, emergency contact
Create the App Store listing (primary language + at least one listing)
Run the automated checks and fix every failure
Submit for review; Shopify emails the submission contact during review
Respond promptly to reviewer questions — repeated non-response or unresolved issues leads to temporary suspension
watchFor: Two or more unresolved reviewer exchanges, growing issue counts, or ignoring review emails gets the app Suspended — each repeat lengthens the suspension
Submitting beta versions or incomplete submissions can delay or forfeit approval
You cannot request protected customer data access while the app is under review — sequence it first
Using 'Shopify' (or lookalike spellings) in domains/emails violates the Partner Program Agreement
Suspension applies per-app only, not to the whole Partner account
countsAsLive: App passes review and its public listing resolves at apps.shopify.com/<handle> with install button and reviews enabled
unknowns: Typical review duration — not stated on the submission page
Exact contents of the automated check suite
